items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: I don't remember him. He might have been downtown more. Most likely I've seen him, but I mean, I don't remember.

ctx.x: Another bass drummer, Trepanier. Did you ever see him?
I don't remember him. He might have been downtown more. Most likely I've seen him, but I mean, I don't remember.
